name: Southeast Asian Home Remedies
summary: Salabat, lemongrass steam, calamansi, cháo hành and coconut water from Southeast Asia.

remedies.name: Salabat
remedies.howItHelps: Filipino ginger tea, sipped warm to soothe a scratchy throat.
steps: Grown-up boils sliced ginger in water for 10 minutes.
Add a little honey or brown sugar.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Calamansi Juice with Honey
remedies.howItHelps: Little calamansi limes bring vitamin C, and honey coats the throat.
steps: Stir in a spoon of honey.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Herbal Steam
remedies.howItHelps: Vietnamese families breathe steam from a pot of lemongrass, ginger and leaves to clear a stuffy nose.
steps: Grown-up boils lemongrass, ginger and herbs.
Sit at a safe distance with a towel over your head.
Breathe slowly for a few minutes.
remedies.caution: Hot water! Only with a grown-up, and never lean too close.

remedies.name: Cháo Hành
remedies.howItHelps: Rice porridge with spring onion and ginger: warm, gentle and easy to eat when you're poorly.
steps: Cook rice in lots of water until soft.
Stir in chopped spring onion and a little ginger.

remedies.name: Fresh Coconut Water
remedies.howItHelps: Coconut water has natural salts like potassium that you lose when you sweat.
steps: Sip cool coconut water slowly in the shade.

remedies.name: Ginger Lemongrass Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Ginger settles a queasy tummy and lemongrass smells calming.
steps: Simmer ginger slices and a lemongrass stalk.
Let it cool till warm and sip.
